label: agent
scenario: Very low-latency, clipped voice agent (sub-half-second turn gaps) declares a gym membership cancelled and refuses any written confirmation.
task: Cancel Derek Lawson's Pulse Fitness membership because he's moving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pulse Fitness, how can I help?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of member Derek Lawson. he'd like to cancel his membership.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it. Derek Lawson, Premium plan. Reason for cancelling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood. Your membership is cancelled. You won't be billed again.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: does he need to provide proof of the move, or give thirty days notice?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No proof needed. No notice period. It's done.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: can you email a written confirmation or give me a cancellation number?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not necessary. The cancellation is effective immediately.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: okay. so no further charges after today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Correct. No further charges after today.
